  mechanical pipeline: `sed` tag-window extract to a marker file, `grep` the
  end tag + char cap, `grep` the verdict/blocker-tag lines, then

  exposure is all four doubled marker-mode sites, not just code-review.

  routed through an intermediary. Two twins emit the section today:

  SKILL.md Step 5c-ter (line ~3423) reads `list-concerns --open-only --json`
  and branches on NIT / CONCERN / BLOCKER, with the autonomous-mode rule
  bouncing to the implementer rather than deferring; `code-reviewer.md`

  degrade to a silent vacuous pass on an empty ledger — the failure has no
  symptom, which is why #2321 needed a composer to improvise a detection
  contract before anyone saw it.
- **The ledger is sound; only its inflow is broken.** `concerns.jsonl` is an
  append-only per-task sidecar mirrored to `events.jsonl` as
  `epm:concern-{raised,addressed,deferred,verified-open}`
  (`task_workflow.py:8294+`), covered by `tests/test_task_workflow.py`. The
  protocol landed at #455; #767 / #1089 / #1459 / #1867 / #2121 / #2219 are
